verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect support: an asynchronous job API lets you trigger runs, monitor status and inspect files that failed. That suggests failures surface rather than disappear silently. There is also a marketing claim of 'resilient partitioning logic' and per-page routing of partition strategy. Nothing addresses very large documents or files specifically. Missing for 10: documented page-count and file-size limits, timeout behavior for thousand-page or multi-GB inputs, large-PDF splitting or parallel page processing, guarantees against truncation, and any hands-on or independent corroboration at scale.
